dimension.description: Pull request stays on one topic
dimension.instructions: Using the PR title, description and changed file paths, judge whether the changes serve one reviewable purpose. Related modules do not make independent goals related: a platform-specific fix and an unrelated agent fix remain two purposes even if both address the same OS. Conversely, a migration across many files, its tests and its dependency cleanup are one purpose. Judge purpose, not number of files or diff size.
criteria: Two or more independent goals that should be reviewed separately, even if they share a platform or component.
A main goal with substantial independent work.
One goal with a small unrelated change.
All changes support one clear purpose, including necessary tests and cleanup.
